task_title: Exit asset worker promptly after durable producer completion

plan_review.notes: Adopted unique per-run marker cleanup/preflight; executable shell success/failure/signal/pre-exit tests; concurrency=2 worker integration benchmark; explicit post-marker next-run boundary; documented acceptable preexisting-backlog processing before ingest completes.

independent_grade.notes: The change expertly implements the durable producer completion marker, replacing arbitrary polling with a robust file-based orchestration. The bash wrapper correctly handles cleanup and restricts secret scope, while the worker cleanly tracks the idle boundary and handles all concurrency races. The fix to the lock tail memory leak ensures reliable concurrency cleanup. Test coverage is extremely thorough, explicitly hitting race windows and verifying signal handling and exit codes.
